known_issues.scope: An earlier M12.2 candidate's initial concurrent QEMU BIOS SATA installation
known_issues.observation: An earlier M12.2 candidate hit the existing AHCI timeout and installation reported failure. A fresh repeat passed; the corrected palette candidate has separate matching tests. The trigger is not isolated and stress reliability is not qualified.

stages.title: Inventory and design contract
stages.deliverable: A complete surface inventory, interaction/state contract and original concept screens.
stages.how_and_why: Reuse proven M11 mechanisms while exposing missing or inconsistent experiences.
stages.acceptance: Check every owner requirement, source-backed inventory, state coverage, original concept rendering and English publication.

stages.title: Shared visual components
stages.deliverable: Semantic typography, spacing, colors, buttons, fields, lists, scrollbars and focus states.
stages.how_and_why: Shared drawing and hit-testing rules prevent each screen drifting into a different interface.
stages.acceptance: Native light/dark component states, text fit, focus, actual scaling and retained-memory/idle measurements.

stages.title: Icon system
stages.deliverable: Original app, action, folder, file-type and device icons across shell surfaces.
stages.how_and_why: Recognizable silhouettes replace ambiguous letter badges; bounded shared assets avoid per-window duplication.
stages.acceptance: All shipped app identities at small/large scales, themes, missing-icon fallback and cache bounds.

stages.title: Desktop and shortcuts
stages.deliverable: Consistent desktop layout, icon labels, alignment, selection, background menu and Recycle Bin.
stages.how_and_why: Keep user objects and built-in launchers predictable and independently removable.
stages.acceptance: Select/open/marquee/rename/pin/recycle routes, persistence, overflow and protected core services.

stages.title: Windows and title bars
stages.deliverable: Consistent app identity, active/inactive chrome, caption controls, borders and reachable window grips.
stages.how_and_why: Preserve proven signed clipping and owner/focus semantics while refining presentation.
stages.acceptance: Move/resize/minimize/maximize/restore/close, inactive state, dirty-close review, keyboard and screen bounds.

stages.title: One Files environment
stages.deliverable: A common frame and real history for native folders, drives and USB, with Back/Forward/Up and address/sidebar navigation.
stages.how_and_why: The provider changes capabilities, never the basic navigation model.
stages.acceptance: Documents to USB to a directory to Back/Forward/Home, no-device state, detach and truthful title/path updates.

stages.title: File presentation
stages.deliverable: Readable details/icons, columns, sorting, selection, full-name tips and actual provider metadata.
stages.how_and_why: Make content scannable without inventing timestamps or expanding filesystem limits cosmetically.
stages.acceptance: Long supported names, sort stability, narrow windows, selection identity, metadata truth and saved view.

stages.title: File commands and transfers
stages.deliverable: Consistent toolbar/context commands, transfer feedback, cancellation, conflicts and supported Undo.
stages.how_and_why: Reuse checked storage transactions and preserve sources across interruption.
stages.acceptance: Native and USB copy/move/refusal, protected locations, partial completion, cancellation and independent stored bytes.

stages.title: Shared file dialogs
stages.deliverable: Reusable Open, Save as and Choose folder with real navigation, validation and remembered appropriate location.
stages.how_and_why: Apps should not each invent a different file-selection experience.
stages.acceptance: Open/save/cancel from supported apps, owner modality, extension filtering, conflicts and missing destinations.

stages.title: Start and local search
stages.deliverable: Recognizable app results, concise layout, categories, pins and clear result types.
stages.how_and_why: Preserve installed catalogue identity, local privacy and existing customization.
stages.acceptance: Search/launch/pin/category/remove and keyboard routes; bounded on-demand search with no idle scanner.

stages.title: Taskbar
stages.deliverable: Consistent app icons, running/active/minimized states, bounded window grouping and context actions.
stages.how_and_why: A launcher and its running windows should have coherent identity without ambiguous duplicate buttons.
stages.acceptance: Multiple windows, minimize/restore/group actions, overflow, pin ordering and optional app removal.

stages.title: Multitasking
stages.deliverable: Refined switcher and discoverable snap choices/assist within actual window and display limits.
stages.how_and_why: Build on working M11 geometry rather than replacing its tested state machine.
stages.acceptance: Mouse/keyboard snap, preview/cancel, normal-bounds restoration, switching, minimum sizes and quota refusal.

stages.title: System tray and quick settings
stages.deliverable: Clock/calendar, device status, safe removal and controls backed by real providers.
stages.how_and_why: Expose useful everyday system actions while keeping unsupported hardware functions explicit.
stages.acceptance: Real network/audio/device state, unavailable reasons, safe remove, keyboard navigation and bounded updates.

stages.title: Settings and personalization
stages.deliverable: A consistent settings hierarchy, previews, persisted preferences and explicit default restoration.
stages.how_and_why: Theme/profile data must customize presentation without bypassing safety or coupling optional apps to the base.
stages.acceptance: Apply/cancel/reset, independent startup, malformed settings refusal and removable-app independence.

stages.title: Feedback and errors
stages.deliverable: Shared empty/loading/success/refusal/error states, useful notifications and owner-scoped reviews.
stages.how_and_why: Explain what happened and the next useful action without interrupting unrelated work.
stages.acceptance: Missing USB, failed saves/transfers, notification bounds, actionable recovery and preserved work.
carry_forward: Fit the shared window-menu helper footer completely; its current bounded ellipsis and full handbook instructions are recorded during M12.4 visual review.
Qualify active/background transfer and global picker/conflict-review admission without stealing existing owners.
Clarify Start global search versus browse scope and clear stale pin-success notices when a query changes.
Distinguish an unsaved new Editor document from a saved existing document and independently verify file absence/persistence.
Fit owner-aware shared shell notices without spilling across unrelated Files footers.
Use plain user-choice wording for malformed Settings recovery and a contextual System-category idle footer; provide a useful route back to an existing file review when appropriate.

stages.title: Installer and first use
stages.deliverable: Apply shared components and terminology across eight steps, recovery and the first installed desktop.
stages.how_and_why: Maintain the proven destructive-consent and actual installed-boot contracts while improving consistency.
stages.acceptance: Every setup step, Back/cancel, disk/partition operations, write failure, recovery and real reset/detached startup.

stages.title: Accessibility
stages.deliverable: Keyboard-complete routes, visible focus, contrast, text/display scaling, reduced motion and semantic control identities.
stages.how_and_why: Accessibility participates from M12.1; this stage qualifies it across complete tasks.
stages.acceptance: Keyboard-only tasks, focus order, light/dark/high-contrast, supported scales and reduced motion. Screen-reader support requires its own working protocol/reader.
carry_forward: Check the drawn guest cursor against actual caption and client hit coordinates after 150%/200% changes. M12.4 raw 4K captures suggest a cursor-position discrepancy; isolate capture timing versus native pointer rendering before final qualification.

stages.title: Motion and performance
stages.deliverable: Direct feedback and bounded optional transitions, shared caches and measured CPU/RAM behavior.
stages.how_and_why: Keep the native lightweight compositor; decoration must not impose continuous work or large per-window surfaces.
stages.acceptance: Peak/retained memory, event/paint observations, idle CPU halt, interrupted transitions and pixel-correct ordinary/HiDPI/4K motion.

stages.title: Final qualification and publication
stages.deliverable: One frozen final ISO/starter, complete task regression, release assets and fresh website/manual verification.
stages.how_and_why: Stage passes cannot qualify different final bytes or broaden hardware/Windows compatibility.
stages.acceptance: Final native desktop/setup/USB/error/memory tests, all named controller profiles, original 7-Zip MSI lifecycle, exact source/assets and public readback.
carry_forward: Revisit the BrixCanvas article custom-domain email-sharing observation in evidence/M12/12/website-observations.json during final website qualification.

publication_gate: Implementation or explicitly labelled design evidence
Canonical GitHub commit and visible scoped delivery
Fresh BrixCanvas homepage, article, index and download readback

constraints.core: Independent native kernel and desktop; no Electron/browser runtime
constraints.assets: Original artwork and existing licensed Inter; no copied Windows product assets
constraints.storage: Separate M12 build/artifact/evidence paths; large disposable fixtures outside OneDrive
constraints.scope: Named VM/device providers; no new GPU 3D, arbitrary Windows support, filesystem capabilities or physical hardware claims
constraints.safety: Destructive review, target revalidation and required-service protection survive every theme/profile
constraints.resources: No idle polling, unbounded caches or full 4K backing buffer per window
